headline: Tasteful Components, Made to Stand Out.
sub: One UI is a free, open-source collection of animated React components. Browse them in action below and install any component with the shadcn CLI or <mcp>MCP</mcp>.
showcaseSub: Just one file for each component. Add it with the shadcn CLI, using any package manager you like.
componentsSub: Every component is a single file you own, not a dependency you install. Add any of them with the shadcn CLI, or from <mcp>MCP</mcp>.
